cues.text: 我在贝尔维尔住了一年多。
cues.textEn: I had lived in Belleville for over a year.

cues.text: 窗上的告示写着私家侦探，电话还没装，也没什么人来敲门。
cues.textEn: The sign in my window said private detective. No telephone yet, and hardly anyone at the door.

cues.text: 我替人找过东西，跟过几个不愿回家的丈夫。
cues.textEn: I had found lost things and followed a few husbands reluctant to go home.

cues.text: 最近一件委托，已经是几个月以前了。
cues.textEn: My last case was months ago.

cues.text: 房东倒很准时。两天以后，四十块。
cues.textEn: The landlord was punctual, though. Two days. Forty dollars.
